brief:
An investigation by the Financial Times and nonprofit journalism organization Lighthouse Reports has documented widespread destruction across southern Lebanon under Israeli occupation, Shehab Wire reported. The joint inquiry found that tens of thousands of homes and schools have been damaged in multiple areas of the occupied region.

The collaborative investigation represents one of the first detailed accountings of the scale of residential destruction in southern Lebanon following Israeli military operations in the territory. The findings underscore the extent of civilian infrastructure damage across the occupied zones, though specific details regarding the timeline and circumstances of individual demolitions remain under examination.
